title: Real-Time Fraud Scoring for a Payments Processor
text:
Industry: FinTech / Payments | Client: Ledgerline Payments
Technologies: Python, Kafka, XGBoost, Redis, AWS EKS, Grafana
Business Challenge: Ledgerline's rules-based fraud engine flagged too many legitimate transactions and missed new attack patterns. Analysts reviewed 40,000 alerts a week by hand, and chargebacks were rising.
Approach: Brightline replaced the batch rules with a streaming scoring service. Transactions flow through Kafka, features are served from Redis, and a gradient-boosted model scores each payment in under 50 ms. Analysts label disputed cases in a review tool, and the model retrains weekly on those labels.
Key Results:
- 38% fewer chargebacks in the first two quarters
- False-positive alerts cut from 40,000 to 11,000 per week
- p99 scoring latency of 42 ms at 3,000 transactions per second

title: Loan Origination Platform Rebuild for a Digital Lender
text:
Industry: FinTech / Lending | Client: Harborview Lending
Technologies: Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Temporal, React, AWS
Business Challenge: Harborview ran loan applications through a vendor platform that was expensive to license, slow to change, and required manual re-keying of borrower data into three downstream systems.
Approach: Brightline built a custom origination platform in phases. Long-running loan workflows run on Temporal, credit bureau and income verification APIs are integrated directly, and an admin console lets the operations team change underwriting steps without a code release.
Key Results:
- 45% lower annual platform cost after retiring the vendor license
- Average time from application to decision cut from 9 days to 3 days
- Manual data re-entry eliminated across 3 downstream systems

title: Customer Support Assistant for a Neobank
text:
Industry: FinTech / Banking | Client: US Neobank (NDA)
Technologies: Python, FastAPI, Claude API, PostgreSQL, Zendesk API
Business Challenge: A fast-growing neobank's support team could not keep up with ticket volume. Half of incoming tickets were questions already answered in the help center, but agents still wrote every reply by hand.
Approach: Brightline built an assistant that drafts replies from the bank's help-center articles and account policies, with a citation to the source article on every draft. Agents approve or edit each draft inside Zendesk. An evaluation suite of 300 real tickets runs before every prompt change.
Key Results:
- 52% of tickets resolved with an agent-approved draft and no rewrite
- Median first-response time cut from 6 hours to 40 minutes
- Zero drafts sent without human approval

title: Personalized Product Recommendations for an Outdoor Retailer
text:
Industry: Retail / E-commerce | Client: Summit & Trail
Technologies: Python, PyTorch, BigQuery, Vertex AI, Shopify Plus
Business Challenge: Summit & Trail showed the same best-sellers to every shopper. Repeat purchase rates were flat, and the merchandising team spent hours each week hand-picking product carousels.
Approach: Brightline trained a two-tower recommendation model on three years of order and browsing history, served through Vertex AI. The team ran a six-week A/B test against the hand-picked carousels before the full rollout.
Key Results:
- 14% lift in average order value in the A/B test
- 9% increase in repeat purchase rate over two quarters
- Merchandising team saved about 12 hours per week

title: Mobile App Rewrite for a Specialty Grocery Chain
text:
Industry: Retail / Grocery | Client: Greenleaf Market
Technologies: Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Node.js, Stripe
Business Challenge: Greenleaf's separate iOS and Android apps had drifted apart in features, crashed often, and took two teams to maintain. App store ratings had fallen below 3 stars.
Approach: Brightline rebuilt both apps as one Flutter codebase with a shared design system, added curbside pickup ordering, and set up automated release builds with crash reporting.
Key Results:
- App store rating raised from 2.8 to 4.6 stars
- Crash-free sessions improved from 96.1% to 99.7%
- Curbside pickup grew to 18% of online orders within six months

title: Inventory Forecasting for a Multi-Brand Apparel Retailer
text:
Industry: Retail / Apparel | Client: Threadhouse Group
Technologies: Python, LightGBM, Snowflake, dbt, Airflow
Business Challenge: Threadhouse planned inventory in spreadsheets for 400 stores. Popular sizes sold out while slow sellers were marked down at the end of each season.
Approach: Brightline built store-and-size-level demand forecasts in Snowflake, orchestrated with Airflow, and a replenishment report that planners review each Monday. Forecast accuracy is tracked against actual sales every week.
Key Results:
- 21% reduction in end-of-season markdowns
- Stockouts on top-selling sizes down 30%
- Forecasts cover 400 stores and 12,000 SKUs

title: Clinical Trial Document Search for a Biotech Company
text:
Industry: Life Sciences / Biotech | Client: Corvane Therapeutics
Technologies: Python, Elasticsearch, OpenAI API, Azure, SharePoint
Business Challenge: Corvane's clinical team spent hours searching thousands of protocol documents, amendments, and site reports stored across SharePoint folders to answer regulator questions.
Approach: Brightline indexed the document library with hybrid keyword and semantic search and built an assistant that answers questions with links to the exact page of each source document. Answers without a supporting source are refused.
Key Results:
- Time to answer a regulator question cut from 2 days to 3 hours
- 25,000 documents indexed across 14 trials
- Every answer links to a source page

title: Patient Intake Automation for a Clinic Network
text:
Industry: Healthcare / Provider | Client: US Clinic Network (NDA)
Technologies: Python, AWS Textract, HL7 FHIR, n8n, PostgreSQL
Business Challenge: Front-desk staff at 35 clinics typed insurance cards and intake forms into the electronic health record by hand, causing check-in delays and claim denials from typos.
Approach: Brightline built an intake pipeline that reads scanned forms and insurance cards, checks the extracted fields against the payer's eligibility API, and writes verified records to the health record system through FHIR. Low-confidence fields go to a staff review queue.
Key Results:
- Check-in time reduced by 7 minutes per patient
- Claim denials from data-entry errors down 60%
- Rolled out to 35 clinics in four months

title: Remote Monitoring Platform for a Medical Device Maker
text:
Industry: Life Sciences / Medical Devices | Client: Pulsewise Medical
Technologies: Kotlin, Swift, AWS IoT Core, TimescaleDB, React
Business Challenge: Pulsewise's heart monitors stored readings on the device, so physicians only saw data when patients came in for appointments.
Approach: Brightline built companion mobile apps that sync device readings over Bluetooth, a cloud pipeline on AWS IoT Core, and a physician dashboard that flags abnormal readings. The team supported the client's regulatory documentation for the software.
Key Results:
- Physicians see readings within 5 minutes instead of at the next visit
- 22,000 patients enrolled in the first year
- 99.95% data delivery rate from device to dashboard

title: Route Optimization for a Regional Delivery Fleet
text:
Industry: Logistics / Last-Mile Delivery | Client: Crossroads Freight
Technologies: Python, Google OR-Tools, PostgreSQL, PostGIS, React Native
Business Challenge: Dispatchers at Crossroads planned routes for 220 trucks by hand each morning. Routes overlapped, drivers ran overtime, and late deliveries were common.
Approach: Brightline built a routing service that plans all routes overnight with time windows and truck capacity, plus a driver app that re-plans the rest of the route when a stop is delayed.
Key Results:
- 17% fewer miles driven per delivery
- On-time delivery rate improved from 86% to 97%
- Morning planning time cut from 3 hours to 20 minutes

title: Warehouse Management System Modernization
text:
Industry: Logistics / Warehousing | Client: Northgate Distribution
Technologies: .NET, Azure, SQL Server, Kubernetes, React
Business Challenge: Northgate's 15-year-old warehouse system ran on a single on-premise server. Peak-season slowdowns stopped picking for hours at a time, and adding a new warehouse took months.
Approach: Brightline moved the system to Azure one module at a time, starting with receiving and picking, while the old system kept running. Each warehouse was cut over on a weekend with a rollback plan.
Key Results:
- Zero hours of peak-season downtime after migration
- New warehouse onboarding cut from 4 months to 3 weeks
- Infrastructure cost down 28%

title: Streaming Video Platform Scale-Up for a Sports Network
text:
Industry: Media / Streaming | Client: Fieldhouse Sports Network
Technologies: Go, AWS MediaLive, CloudFront, DynamoDB, Terraform
Business Challenge: Fieldhouse's streaming service crashed during its two biggest live events of the year, when traffic jumped to ten times normal within minutes.
Approach: Brightline rebuilt the playback and entitlement services in Go, moved video delivery to a multi-CDN setup, and ran load tests at 15 times expected peak before each major event.
Key Results:
- 1.2 million concurrent viewers served at the championship final with no outage
- Video start time cut from 6.5 seconds to 1.8 seconds
- Infrastructure scales up automatically ahead of scheduled events

title: Content Tagging with Machine Learning for a Publisher
text:
Industry: Media / Publishing | Client: Brookfield Press Digital
Technologies: Python, Hugging Face Transformers, AWS SageMaker, Elasticsearch
Business Challenge: Editors tagged 600 articles a day by hand. Tags were inconsistent, so related-article links and topic pages were weak and search traffic was flat.
Approach: Brightline fine-tuned a text classifier on 200,000 previously tagged articles and built a tagging step into the publishing tool. Editors confirm or change the suggested tags before publishing.
Key Results:
- 91% of suggested tags accepted by editors without changes
- Organic search traffic to topic pages up 33%
- About 25 editor hours saved per week

title: Claims Processing Automation for an Insurance Carrier
text:
Industry: Insurance | Client: US Insurance Carrier (NDA)
Technologies: Python, Claude API, AWS Step Functions, DynamoDB, Guidewire
Business Challenge: Adjusters spent most of their time reading claim documents and copying details into Guidewire. Simple auto-glass claims waited in the same queue as complex injury claims.
Approach: Brightline built a document-reading step that extracts claim details with a large language model, checks each extracted value against the policy record, and routes simple claims to a fast-track queue. Every extraction is logged with its source text for audit.
Key Results:
- 40% of auto-glass claims settled same day
- Adjuster time per simple claim cut from 45 minutes to 10 minutes
- Extraction accuracy of 97% on a 1,000-claim audit set

title: Energy Usage Analytics for a Utility Company
text:
Industry: Energy / Utilities | Client: Clearwater Power
Technologies: Python, Apache Spark, Databricks, Power BI, Azure
Business Challenge: Clearwater collected smart-meter readings from 900,000 homes but could only report on them monthly. Demand spikes surprised grid operators, and customers had no view of their own usage.
Approach: Brightline built a Databricks pipeline that processes meter readings every 15 minutes, a demand forecast for grid operators, and a usage view in the customer web portal.
Key Results:
- Day-ahead demand forecast error reduced to 3.5%
- 120,000 customers enrolled in peak-time savings within a year
- Meter data available in 15 minutes instead of monthly

title: Internal Knowledge Assistant for a Software Consultancy
text:
Industry: Professional Services | Client: Brightline Engineering (internal)
Technologies: Python, FastAPI, Claude API, Slack Bolt, Google Drive API, Google Cloud Run
Business Challenge: Brightline's sales team could not quickly find which past projects matched a prospect's needs. Case studies lived in scattered documents, and salespeople asked engineers in Slack instead.
Approach: Brightline built a Slack assistant that answers questions over every published case study, with a link to each source. An evaluation suite built from real sales questions runs before every deploy, and a check blocks any answer that names a case study not in the library.
Key Results:
- Answers in under 10 seconds instead of a day of Slack back-and-forth
- Covers 100% of published case studies
- Zero invented case studies reached users after the check shipped
